questions.question: Which resume bullet is strongest?
options: "Built a study-tracking app with React and TypeScript, with automated tests"
questions.explanation: Action verb + what you built + tools + a concrete detail or result.

questions.question: Should you list a technology you only watched one video about?
options: No, only list what you can confidently discuss in an interview
questions.explanation: Interviewers ask about what's on your resume. Honesty builds trust.
